summary: Completed full backend + frontend E2E testing for Oakbridge Publishing MVP. 19/19 backend pytest tests PASS. Frontend flows verified: home, catalog (filters/search/sort), book detail, cart sheet, cart page, checkout submission, order confirmation with OAK- order number, newsletter, contact form, solutions/about pages, and cart localStorage persistence across reload.

issues: Accessibility warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for <DialogContent>. Add a <SheetDescription> (visually hidden if desired) to satisfy Radix a11y requirements.
Hydration warning: cannot be a child of

action_items: Optional: add SheetDescription/VisuallyHidden description in CartSheet to clear Radix a11y warning.
Optional: investigate if the <span> inside <option> hydration warning is caused by the shared Emergent dev overlay; no action required if it's platform-level.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~430 LOC file with seed data inline — acceptable for an MVP but recommend splitting seed data to /app/backend/seeds/ if the catalogue grows.

Good practices observed: {'_id': 0} projection on all Mongo reads (no ObjectId leak), UUID ids, Pydantic validation (EmailStr), proper 400/404 HTTPExceptions, CORS via env, idempotent newsletter signup, order number format OAK-YYMMDD-XXXXXX.
No auth (by design — guest checkout). No rate limiting on /newsletter, /contact, /orders — acceptable for MVP but worth noting for production hardening.
Frontend data-testid coverage is excellent on every interactive element — facilitated fast E2E testing.
seed_data_creation: None — backend auto-seeds 5 categories + 30 books on startup. Tests created TEST_-prefixed newsletter/contact/order records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover all /api endpoints. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend uses native <select> for sort and contact subject — use page.select_option(), not page.fill(). Order number format is 'OAK-YYMMDD-XXXXXX'. Cart persists via localStorage. Checkout is MOCKED — no real payment; order is saved directly to Mongo `orders` collection.
rca of the issue: No app bugs found. Console warnings (<span> in <option>, missing DialogContent description) are non-blocking and likely from the dev instrumentation overlay + a Radix a11y recommendation.
